breaking.change: Remote `<iframe src="https://…">` frames are gone with the old UI core, together with project.ogt's `frames` setting and the `*-frames` web engine variants it chose. `og build` now refuses a project.ogt that still names `frames`.
breaking.fix: Delete the `frames` line from project.ogt. Build what the remote page showed as game UI from TSX components.

breaking.change: An `http(s)://` image in a `url()` is no longer fetched at run time, with its `integrity()` modifier: images come only from the game's cooked assets.
breaking.fix: Download the image into the game's assets and name it by its asset path.
